description: Test vectors of the protocol (protocol.md section 13). Generated by `cargo run -p credential-enclave-protocol --bin vectors` from fixed inputs. Byte values are base64url without padding. A key ending in `_text` holds the same bytes as UTF-8 text. An `hpke_seed` is the input keying material of the HPKE ephemeral key pair: the pair is DeriveKeyPair(hpke_seed) of RFC 9180 section 7.1.3. `log_v3` is the credential log of format 3 (the releases from v2.4.0 on: the key of an object carries the time, the node and the body_hash of its entry) with the node document of its node, `log_store` the buckets of format 3 of a log store, `log` the log of format 2 (the releases from v2.0.0 to v2.3.0: the key carries body_hash and entry_hash, and the node signed heads) and `log_v1` the log of format 1 (one entry holds one event). `vault_secret` holds a record of that kind and the verdicts of the form rules of its plaintext: `valid` says whether a string is a name, a host or a slot, and whether `sites` and `slots` together are a reach. A host and a slot of the request of a secret use have the same form rules. `reserved_headers` lists the slot of every header no slot names. `sealed_release` holds a `release` call that named a key to seal the value to: `receiver_private` is the X25519 private key of the caller, `seal_to` its public key, and `sealed` the object of the response, which opens to `value_text` under the HPKE info `info_text` and the AAD `aad_text`. `basic_credentials` holds values of an `Authorization` header of a request whose slot is one of the two of HTTP Basic: `slot` is the slot of the half of the credentials the placeholder `placeholder_text` stands for (`basic:user` or `basic:password`), the one slot a node of the forward role sends the request under, or is null for a value it sends under neither, and `written_text` is the header that node writes for the value `value_text`. `header_values` holds values of the header of a request whose slot is `header:<name>`, with the placeholder `placeholder_text` in them: `valid` says whether a node of the forward role puts a value in the place of the placeholder, and `refused_schemes` lists the names of the authentication schemes behind which it puts none. `subset` holds the delegation subset (protocol.md 10.4). A case of `cases` is a pool of `pods` nodes with `copies` nodes per account, with the group of every ordinal in `groups` or without groups, and `skip` groups passed over: `assign` lists the ordinals that hold the delegation of `user_id` in the order the account takes them. Without `groups`, `ranked` lists every ordinal in the order of its rank. With `groups`, `group_order` lists the groups in the order of the account and `group_ranked` the ordinals of each of them, in the same order, by their rank. `pools` holds two pools whose nodes run in the same groups, and for each account its nodes in both and the three groups those nodes run in. `objects` holds `subset` objects of a request: `valid` says whether a node reads the object or answers `invalid_request`.
